svg.desc: Quest log — CareMotion (2026): edge-ai parkinson’s screening, platinum at Coding Thailand 2026; Doodee Move (2026): line bot for public transport, grand prize at IIC CUP 2026; Doodee Future (2025): all-in-one uni admissions prep, gold at SWU Researcher Day; ChickChick (2025): thermal-camera smart farm, winner at ENVI Mahidol Hackathon
